title: Dây trầm
about: Round x5 of the dark ambient style (khong-gian), as the user asked ("hãy sáng tác thêm cho tôi nhiều bài nữa"): low strings in the dark, as a film's slow, grave scene: the section holding close low chords, a single string singing a sad tune over it, the great bell under the climax. C minor at 48 bpm. An original piece.
